assertions.name: tau_M_T_beta_matches_target_at_q0
assertions.source: min-L2-norm SDP exactly reproduces τ_M(T_β) = Q_β/E_0 at q_0

description: β-decay knot operator T_β identified as the min-L2-norm element of H_3(q)'s NF basis satisfying τ_M(T_β) = Q_β/E_0 at q_0. Provides the symbolic τ_M(T_β)(q) function and its Taylor expansion around q=1. The Taylor coefficients are the data from which the c_k precision-ladder coefficients can be extracted (after subtracting Q_A and cos contributions).

data.structural_finding: T_β is identified as a 6-coefficient NF expansion (min-L2-norm). Its τ_M(q) is a sum of z(q)^k contributions for k=0..3. The c_k extraction requires comparing τ_M(T_β)(q) to Q_A(q)·cos(...) term-by-term in (q-1) — a finite algebraic exercise.
